lang.description: The language of this file, zh or en. The sentences from the core are asked for in the same one.

ext_description.message: Save the current page, selected text, a link or an image to KeepEssence. One action, and one sentence when it is done.

menu_selection.message: Save the selected text to KeepEssence

not_connected.message: Not saved yet: this browser is not connected. Queued, and it will be saved once you connect.

why_not_web.message: this is not a web page

why_permission.message: the browser has not allowed the extension to reach the address you set

why_unreachable.message: KeepEssence could not be reached to check this text first

why_cannot_ask.message: this looks like a password or a credential, and this page cannot show the question

why_image.message: the image could not be read

why_queue_full.message: too many are queued; go online so they can be saved

opt_how.message: Click the KeepEssence button in the toolbar, or press $1: the current page is saved, with the selected text when there is one. Right-click a page, selected text, a link or an image: it is saved. Saved, already saved, or not saved: one sentence at the bottom right of the page tells you.

opt_name_hint.message: Shown under Devices. Changing the name gets a new code.

opt_code_say.message: Open KeepEssence on a device with the Manage tier, check this code, and press Allow.

opt_code_waiting.message: Waiting for you to press Allow. The code is valid for $1 minutes and works once.

opt_code_denied.message: Refused. This browser is not connected.

opt_code_expired.message: The code expired. This browser is not connected.

opt_connected.message: Connected. This browser is called “$1”. Its tier is Save only: it cannot see anything you saved.

opt_connected_hint.message: Rename or revoke it in KeepEssence under Assistants › Devices.

opt_disconnect_hint.message: Disconnecting revokes this device at once.

opt_queued.message: $1 queued. They will be saved when you are online and connected.

opt_server_hint.message: Change it only if you host your own. The browser asks once whether the extension may reach it; after a change you connect again, and queued items are not carried over.

opt_server_refused.message: The browser did not allow that address. Nothing was changed.

opt_server_grant.message: The browser has not allowed the extension to reach $1 yet.

opt_privacy.message: This extension works only when you press it. It reads the address and title of the current page and the text you selected, or the link or image you right-clicked, and saves that to your KeepEssence. It reads no other page and nothing else, and collects no data. When you are not pressing it, it does one thing only: it sends what is queued. It cannot see what you saved before. The browser asks for no permission when you install it; it asks once only if you change the address to one you host yourself.
